finding: With no account, no key, no wallet, no signature and no payment on 2026-09-28 at 18:33Z, GET /x402/checkout/info answers 402 rather than 401 or data, and quotes 1000 units of USDC under scheme exact on four networks, the same amount, scheme, timeout and networks as the 2026-09-21 record, which names a different Solana payTo (see the decoded comparison).
